objectives_fil: Bumuo ng before-work checklist para sa station at field visit na may supplies, ruta, reporting contact at malinaw na dahilan kung kailan magpa-pause.
objectives_en: Build a before-work checklist for station work and field visits covering supplies, route, reporting contact and explicit pause conditions.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ihanda ang kontrol at kagamitan; iulat ang kulang bago magsagawa ng hindi ligtas na gawain.
sections.takeaway_en: Prepare controls and equipment; report gaps before undertaking unsafe work.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang ligtas na ruta at malinaw na reporting contact ay kasinghalaga ng listahan ng bibisitahin.
sections.takeaway_en: A safe route and clear reporting contact matter as much as the visit list.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kapag magkakasabay ang hazards, kailangang baguhin ang gawain at humingi ng tamang desisyon.
sections.takeaway_en: Combined hazards may require changing the work and obtaining the appropriate decision.

sections.takeaway_fil: Beripikahin ang kondisyon at pasya; hindi pa ready ang hindi pa nakumpirma.
sections.takeaway_en: Verify conditions and the decision; unconfirmed conditions are not ready.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang checklist ay dapat may desisyon kung ligtas nang magsimula, hindi listahan lamang ng gamit.
sections.takeaway_en: A checklist must support a decision about safe starting conditions, not just list equipment.

sections.takeaway_fil: May ligtas na alternatibong napagkasunduan sa role-play; nakikita pa rin ang hindi pa ready bago magsimula.
sections.takeaway_en: The role-play has an agreed safe alternative; conditions that are not ready remain visible before work begins.

check.prompt_fil: May banta sa ruta ngunit mahaba pa ang visit list. Ano ang ligtas na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: There is a threat on the route but many visits remain. What is safe?

options.fil: Iwasan ang banta at ayusin ang alternatibo kasama ang supervisor.
options.en: Avoid the threat and arrange an alternative with the supervisor.

options.fil: Huwag ipaalam ang pagbabago ng ruta upang hindi makaabala.
options.en: Change the route without telling anyone to avoid disruption.

check.feedback_fil: Una: Ang pagtuloy mag-isa ay pagpasok pa rin sa banta; hindi dahilan ang target. Ikalawa: Iwasan ang banta at ayusin ang alternatibo kasama ang supervisor; kailangan pang kumpirmahin ang kondisyon bago umalis. Ikatlo: Ang hindi pagpapaalam ng bagong ruta ay nag-iiwan sa contact na walang tamang impormasyon tungkol sa lokasyon at oras ng balik. Sa kathang-isip na role-play, napagkasunduan ang mock station briefing muna at pagpapaliban ng apektadong visit. Hindi pa nakumpirma ang bagong ruta at visit contact: hindi pa ready ang visit at hindi ipinapalagay na nawala ang banta. Ulitin ang kasunduan at beripikahin bago magsimula.
check.feedback_en: First: Continuing alone still enters the threat; the target does not justify it. Second: Avoid the threat and arrange an alternative with the supervisor; conditions still need confirmation before departure. Third: Not reporting a new route leaves the contact without accurate location and return-time information. In the fictional role-play, the agreed alternative is a mock station briefing and deferral of the affected visit. The new route and visit contact are unconfirmed: the visit is not ready and the threat is not assumed to have vanished. Repeat the agreement and verify before starting.
